chunk.content: Scenario 3.3.1 Kịch bản brute force và đăng nhập bất thường. Description: Integrated research draft: observed telemetry, inferred correlations, candidate assessments and separate CTI context. Analysis status: draft_reviewable. Observed behavior: Observed 49 successful logons; same-name associations and privileges are context only. Toàn bộ 25993 raw/canonical records đã được đối chiếu; 14 failure observations, 7 correlated attempts, 1 suspected spraying cluster(s), 5 RC4 rule matches. Không xác nhận compromise.

scope_limitations: Use existing canonical timestamp unchanged. Preserve timezone-naive EventTime and @timestamp differences; no timezone correction.
Launch /t is intent only; failure clustering and ticket evidence are evaluated independently.
One failed attempt per account does not establish repeated brute force against a single account. Password sameness is not logged.
Successful logon is observed, but abnormality/causality/compromise requires historical and session context.
Same-name success after failure does not prove recovered password, successful spraying or account compromise. No historical baseline establishes abnormal successful logon.
No cracking success/password recovery is established. CTI campaign activity does not attribute an actor to this dataset.
CTI facts are publisher-reported external context. They do not establish local host compromise, campaign attribution, HTTP completion or confirmed C2.
